features.label: Status Check
features.value: Verifies if the website is online and reachable without any errors.

features.label: Responsive Design
features.value: Ensures your site looks and works great on all devices (mobile, tablet, desktop).

features.label: SSL Certificate Validation
features.value: Checks if your SSL certificate is valid, trusted, and not expired.

features.label: Page Load Speed
features.value: Measures how fast your website loads and flags slow pages.

features.label: Broken Link Detection
features.value: Scans for non-working links that can hurt user experience and SEO.

features.label: Security Headers
features.value: Verifies presence of headers like CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc.

features.label: SEO Tags
features.value: Extracts and validates title, meta description, canonical URL, and robots tag.

features.label: Accessibility
features.value: Checks for basic accessibility best practices for inclusive experience.
